'''Draenell's Spies''' was a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of ten [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] who participated in the raid on [[agricultural loading platform XT-21s]] on [[Draenell's Point]] during the [[Battle of Bissillirus]]. They were each armed with a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], a [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]], and two [[Fragmentation grenade/Legends|fragmentation grenades]]. The squad also carried a [[Medium repeating blaster/Legends|medium repeating blaster]].
